    (b : Module.Basis (Fin r) k M) (B : Type u) [CommRing B] [Algebra k B]

      (LinearMap.baseChange B b.equivFun.toLinearMap) = LinearMap.id := by
    rw [← LinearMap.baseChange_comp]
    simp

    intro x y hxy
